title: 污水紫外線消毒
summary: 本課以UV 透光、流場、劑量與驗證範圍為主線，從前處理與指標菌基線、透光率與光程、照度與時間乘積、水力通道與短流進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops uv transmission, hydraulics, fluence and validation envelope through ten connected units, beginning with pretreatment and indicator baseline, transmittance and optical path, irradiance and exposure time, hydraulic paths and short-circuiting. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 前處理與指標菌基線：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Pretreatment and indicator baseline: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 前處理與指標菌基線 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Pretreatment and indicator baseline and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 消毒目標需區分指標菌與病原；流量和採樣方法決定如何比較處理前後結果。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish indicator organisms from pathogens; flow and sampling methods determine valid before/after comparisons.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：流量=1000 m³/d；指標菌=100 CFU/100 mL。模型 Nday=Q×10000×C，代入得到 1e+09 CFU/d。適用邊界：只計培養法的指標菌通量；不能直接推成所有病原或感染風險。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Flow=1000 m³/d; indicator organisms=100 CFU/100 mL. Model Nday=Q×10000×C gives 1e+09 CFU/d. Applicability: Culture-based indicator-organism flux only, not all pathogens or infection risk.
steps.failure: 用單一指標菌檢測宣稱所有病原已消失。診斷與介入：確認微生物方法及檢出限，與同時段流量配對。
steps.failureEn: One indicator test is used to claim elimination of all pathogens. Diagnostic response: Confirm microbial method/detection limit and pair with matched-period flow.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「前處理與指標菌基線」的觀測點。記錄檢出限、培養法與採樣時刻，避免把未檢出當零。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for pretreatment and indicator baseline. Record detection limit, culture method and sample time; do not equate nondetection to zero. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.text: 只改變 Q:1000→1200 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1e+09 變為 1.2e+09 CFU/d。用「前處理與指標菌基線」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only Q:1000→1200 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1e+09 to 1.2e+09 CFU/d. Explain the direction using pretreatment and indicator baseline, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 透光率與光程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Transmittance and optical path: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 透光率與光程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Transmittance and optical path and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: UVT 必須標明波長與光程；同一水樣的更長光程會衰減更多光。
steps.instructionEn: UVT requires wavelength and path length; longer paths through the same water attenuate more light.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：1 cm UVT=0.80；光程=3 cm。模型 T=T1^l，代入得到 0.512 fraction。適用邊界：均質吸收且忽略散射；透光率不是微生物去除率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: 1-cm UVT=0.80; path length=3 cm. Model T=T1^l gives 0.512 fraction. Applicability: Homogeneous absorption without scattering; transmittance is not microbial removal.
steps.failure: 把 1 cm UVT 當作整座反應器的透光率。診斷與介入：確認波長、光程及空白，再查水質與顆粒變化。
steps.failureEn: One-centimeter UVT is treated as whole-reactor transmittance. Diagnostic response: Confirm wavelength, path length and blank, then check water/particle changes.
